reason: Health restore, re-checked 12 Nov 2026: the health rule no longer stops her (her home page, www.karenroy.life, offers trauma-informed and ADHD-supportive meditation 'for ADHD, anxiety + emotional overwhelm' with no claim to treat a condition), but she is too thin for a listing. Her site is a one-page Wix site whose only offers are a Patreon membership (no tier prices readable on the public page), her Insight Timer page and a 21-day course marked 'coming soon'; no YouTube channel is linked and none was found; no base is published. Her site photos are on static.wixstatic.com, which refuses our robots.txt request, and the Patreon share image is Patreon's generated card, so there is no usable photo. Contact exists (karen@karenroy.life, mailto on her home page). Worth a fresh look once her course is live.
